title: Venue Readiness Verdict
description: VERIFY-stage advisory readiness artifact. The deterministic layer computes it with venue_score.derive_meets_bar() only after the frozen blind-review panel and venue_meta_review pass validation. It is not an acceptance fact or human venue decision. The allOf enforces: if any unresolved reject-trigger is present, verdict must be NOT-YET, WRONG-PATH, or DEGRADED-REVIEW (never MEETS-BAR or BORDERLINE).

verdict.description: Derived verdict. MEETS-BAR: accept-condition fully met, no reject-triggers. BORDERLINE: one non-gating dim short. NOT-YET: reject-trigger(s) fired but resolvable. WRONG-PATH: structural weakness (multiple gating dims <=2). DEGRADED-REVIEW: independence compromised or all confidence<=2.

unresolved_reject_triggers.description: Trigger IDs that remain unresolved across the full review panel. Empty iff no trigger fired.

dimension_synthesis.description: Per-dimension cross-review argument (not a numeric mean — argument-based per ICML policy).

argument.description: The cross-review argument (which reviewer's evidence is harder, key disagreements, agreed weakness). NOT a mean score.

agreed_score.description: Optional: the minimum score across reviews (most-critical), used by venue_score.py for accept-condition check.

gaps.description: For NOT-YET verdict: gap-to-stage-to-fix list (what to add / change to resolve each reject-trigger).

gap.description: Description of the specific gap or missing evidence.

stage.description: Which research stage should address this (S2/S3/S4 or DESIGN/EXECUTE/ANALYZE).

what_to_add.description: Concrete action: what experiment to run, what to fix, what to add.

strengths.description: For MEETS-BAR verdict: key strengths to highlight.

shore_up.description: For MEETS-BAR verdict: remaining weak points to strengthen before submission.

independence_ref.description: Reference to the independence-report artifact (check_review_independence output) used for this verdict.

evidence_ref.description: Anti-slop guard: at least one pointer to the review artifacts this verdict synthesizes.
